test_title: PYST 71: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: The 7th Five-Year Plan is credited with laying the foundation for which of the following major economic reform eras in India?

options.text: Economic liberalization and modernization in the 1990s

solution:
The correct answer is __**Economic liberalization and modernization in the 1990s**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Seventh Five-Year Plan** was implemented from **1985 to 1990** under the premiership of **Rajiv Gandhi**, shifting the economic focus toward **modernization** and **technological self-reliance**.
 
• It is widely credited with laying the groundwork for the **1991 Economic Reforms** by introducing concepts of **industrial liberalization** and reducing the **License Raj** constraints.
 
• The plan emphasized **Food, Work, and Productivity**, aiming to increase efficiency in the **private sector** while reducing the absolute dominance of the public sector.
 
• For the first time in Indian planning history, the **private sector** was given priority over the public sector in terms of investment outlays, creating a precursor to the **Market Economy**.
 
• The **Seventh Plan** achieved a remarkable **GDP growth rate of 6.01%**, significantly higher than the targeted **5.0%**, proving the efficacy of early liberalization measures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nationalization of banks**:

 
 
• The first major phase occurred in **1969** (14 banks) under the **Fourth Five-Year Plan**.
 
• The second phase took place in **1980** (6 banks) during the **Sixth Five-Year Plan**.
 
 
 
• **Green Revolution**:
 
 
• Launched in the mid-**1960s** (specifically **1966**) to address food shortages through **High-Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds** and modern irrigation.
 
• It is primarily associated with the **Annual Plans** (Plan Holidays) and the early **Fourth Five-Year Plan**.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)**:
 
 
• Passed in **September 2005** and renamed as **MGNREGA** in **2009**.
 
• This social security measure was a landmark initiative of the **Tenth Five-Year Plan** (2002−2007).
